problem: Gate19's fixed arm differs only in work accounting; Gate20 compares actual bounded graph mutations with independent fully-trained fixed selectors.

hypotheses.mechanistic: Local spawn/prune/rewire must change active parent edges under unseen causal parent shifts while preserving source A.
hypotheses.scientific: Online local self-assembly predicts truly held B consequences better than matched fully-trained static selectors and strong Bayes.

domains.noise: deterministic 5 percent, domain-separated from data splits
domains.shift: Related B world resamples a different unordered parent set (same truth function with hidden input order); independent_noise labels have no causal parents

learner.dynamic: Start from A-selected order-1..3 graph, evaluate only one-edge add/delete/swap neighbors every fourth B action; permit at most one accepted edit per step. Use B fit outcomes only for B conditional prediction; never use hidden source mapping.
learner.source_model: Penalized leave-one-out risk on A64 with fixed lexicographic tie rule.
learner.fully_fit_static: Independent implementation: globally optimize 1..3-parent topology using all B32 fit observations; no online rewiring; gets same source A and B data.
learner.frozen_A: Keep selected A topology without rewiring, fit B outcome counts
learner.bayesian: Static Beta(1,1) mixture over all 1..3-parent subsets with order-balanced prior trained on B32
learner.null_and_negative: Constant .5 null and B-label permutation negative
learner.compute: Record actual evaluated candidate scores and predictors; do not assert wall-time/FLOP/energy match without measured accounting.

evaluation.score: Held Brier across 16 disjoint B vectors; per-family means and paired normal 95 percent CI for independent fixed-minus-dynamic and Bayesian-minus-dynamic
evaluation.cold: Pack A64 + B prefix + active graph into exactly 260 bytes at B16 and B32; independent re-instantiation continues B16->B32 with identical state and 16 held forecasts. Not a separate-process claim.

verdict_rule: Only all thresholds PASS permits STRUCTURAL_DEV_GAIN_ONLY; otherwise MIXED_DEV/SCIENTIFIC_NEGATIVE_DEV, including any ties. Mutation alone does not show benefit. No original native first-use or accepted intelligence claim.
